views.description: Vista materializada con métricas agregadas del dashboard de clase

joins: LEFT JOIN students s ON c.id = s.classroom_id

views.description: Agregación de completitud de módulos por aula

select_columns: SUM(CASE WHEN sp.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_count
SUM(CASE WHEN sp.status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_progress_count
SUM(CASE WHEN sp.status = 'not_started' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_started_count
joins: LEFT JOIN student_progress sp ON c.id = sp.classroom_id AND m.id = sp.module_id

views.description: Resumen de actividad reciente de cada estudiante

select_columns: EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - MAX(al.timestamp)) as days_inactive
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al.type = 'activity_completed' THEN al.id END) as total_activities_completed
joins: LEFT JOIN activity_logs al ON s.id = al.student_id

views.description: Vista materializada de estudiantes en riesgo con cálculo de nivel de riesgo

select_columns: EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(MAX(al.timestamp), s.created_at)) as days_inactive

CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(MAX(al.timestamp), s.created_at)) > 7 OR COALESCE(s.overall_progress, 0) < 30) THEN 'critical' WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(MAX(al.timestamp), s.created_at)) >= 3 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(MAX(al.timestamp), s.created_at)) <= 7) OR (COALESCE(s.overall_progress, 0) >= 30 AND COALESCE(s.overall_progress, 0) <= 50) THEN 'warning' ELSE 'active' END as risk_level
joins: LEFT JOIN activity_logs al ON s.id = al.student_id

views.description: Timeline de actividades enriquecida con información del estudiante y módulo

joins: INNER JOIN students s ON al.student_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN modules m ON al.module_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN activities a ON al.activity_id = a.id

functions.description: Calcula el progreso general de un estudiante en su clase (promedio de todos los módulos)
functions.logic: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(percentage), 0) FROM student_progress WHERE student_id = p_student_id AND classroom_id = p_classroom_id AND status != 'not_started'

functions.description: Calcula el nivel de riesgo de un estudiante basado en inactividad y progreso
functions.logic: Determina 'critical', 'warning', o 'active' basado en: (1) días sin actividad > 7 O progreso < 30% = crítico, (2) días 3-7 O progreso 30-50% = advertencia, (3) resto = activo

functions.description: Calcula el progreso promedio de todos los estudiantes en una clase
functions.logic: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(COALESCE(overall_progress, 0)), 0) FROM students WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id AND deleted_at IS NULL

functions.description: Calcula métricas de tiempo: total invertido, promedio por sesión, número de sesiones, última sesión
functions.logic: SELECT SUM(duration_seconds) as total_time, AVG(duration_seconds) as avg_session_time, COUNT(*) as total_sessions, MAX(ended_at) as last_session_end FROM student_sessions WHERE student_id = p_student_id AND ended_at IS NOT NULL

functions.description: Obtiene las N actividades más recientes de una clase

parameters.name: p_limit
parameters.description: Número máximo de actividades a retornar

functions.logic: SELECT id, type, student_id, activity_id, module_id, timestamp FROM activity_logs WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT p_limit

functions.description: Obtiene el progreso detallado de un estudiante en todos los módulos de su clase
functions.logic: SELECT module_id, percentage, completed_activities, total_activities, status FROM student_progress WHERE student_id = p_student_id AND classroom_id = p_classroom_id ORDER BY module_id

functions.description: Obtiene el recuento de actividades completadas por día en un rango de fechas
functions.logic: SELECT DATE(timestamp) as date, COUNT(*) as activity_count FROM activity_logs WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id AND timestamp BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND type = 'activity_completed' GROUP BY DATE(timestamp) ORDER BY date DESC

triggers.description: Actualiza student_progress y student_sessions cuando se inserta un activity_log

logic.when_activity_completed: Actualizar student_progress.completed_activities, percentage y status. Actualizar estudiante.overall_progress
logic.when_module_started: Crear o actualizar student_progress con status='in_progress' y started_at

triggers.description: Actualiza classroom_metrics_daily cuando se inserta activity_log
triggers.logic: Actualizar o insertar en classroom_metrics_daily el recuento de actividades del día

triggers.trigger_event: UPDATE ON student_sessions WHEN (OLD.ended_at IS NULL AND NEW.ended_at IS NOT NULL)
triggers.description: Calcula duration_seconds cuando se cierra una sesión

notes: IMPORTANTE: La tabla student_progress es CRÍTICA para la performance del analytics. Debe mantenerse actualizada en tiempo casi real.
Las vistas materializadas v_classroom_dashboard_metrics y v_at_risk_students deben usar REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY para evitar bloqueos.
El sistema de logging de actividades (activity_logs) debe ser extremadamente confiable ya que es la base de todos los reportes.
Considerar índices adicionales basados en patrones de query reales en producción.
El particionamiento de activity_logs debe implementarse pronto para evitar problemas de escalabilidad.
Las métricas de tiempo (student_sessions) son opcionales para MVP pero recomendadas para análisis completo.
RLS policies son críticas para garantizar que profesores solo vean datos de sus aulas.
Los triggers deben tener error handling robusto para no fallar silenciosamente.
